description: Defines the Configuration class for managing hostapd configuration files, including methods for loading, storing, and manipulating VAP settings, as well as iterating over access point VAPs.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Manages hostapd configuration files, providing methods for loading, saving, and editing configuration parameters, including VAP-specific settings.

methods.name: Configuration(const std::string &file_name)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configuration object with a filename.

methods.name: operator bool() const
methods.description: Returns true if the configuration is valid and non-empty.

methods.name: update_required() const
methods.description: Checks if the configuration requires an update.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads configuration from file, with vap indications.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores the current configuration back to the file.

methods.name: set_create_head_value
methods.description: Sets or creates a key/value pair in the head section.

methods.name: get_head_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key from the head section.

methods.name: get_vap_by_bssid
methods.description: Finds a VAP name by its BSSID.

methods.name: set_create_vap_value
methods.description: Sets or creates a key/value pair for a specific VAP.

methods.name: set_create_value
methods.description: Sets or creates a key/value pair either for a VAP or the head section.

methods.name: get_vap_value
methods.description: Gets the value of a key for a specific VAP.

methods.name: disable_vap
methods.description: Disables a VAP by setting start_disabled and removing ssid.

methods.name: for_all_ap_vaps
methods.description: Applies a function to all VAPs that match a predicate.

methods.name: get_last_message
methods.description: Returns the last internal message for debugging.
